sloka: अलं वत्से रुदित्वा ते न भेतव्यं च सर्वशः ।दानमानप्रसादैस्त्वां तोषयिष्यामि यत्नतः ।। ७.२४.३२ ॥
transliteration: alaṁ vatse ruditvā te na bhetavyaṁ ca sarvaśaḥ ।dānamānaprasādaistvāṁ toṣayiṣyāmi yatnataḥ ।। 7.24.32 ॥

translations.english: Ravana told her to stop weeping and not to fear, promising to satisfy her with great effort through gifts, honors, and favors.
